status: Proposed interface contract; no selected protocol/devices, certification or operating limits

module: two intended field orientations with candidate Tx/Rx channels
host: depollution, metering and singulation into narrow lane
boundary.scope_note: Grey host is partial reference. Full-width retrofit and universal bolt-on compatibility not established.

mechanical.axes: X travel, Y across, Z up
mechanical.checked_pose: Nominal assembly only; all dimensions proposed
requires: surveyed host interfaces and support/return clearance
mechanical.coil_gap_definition: Bare winding core maximum, excluding separate terminal pins; main paths have out-of-plane recessed returns.

required_system: Stable drive/receive phase reference and common timebase
Characterized channel, acquisition and demodulation delays
Coherent complex response capture with calibrated gain/phase and saturation detection
acquisition.warning: A generic PLC digital input does not acquire these complex induction signals. Frequency, channels, bandwidth, ADC and analog hardware remain unselected.

association.encoder_meaning: Belt travel proxy, not item-position accuracy or fragment motion
requires: characterize belt/fragment slip, bounce, roll and overlapping objects
optical reassociation or other independent checks where needed
validate ramps, stops, missed triggers and loss of encoder
association.simultaneity: The same object reaches A and B at different times; no simultaneous two-station claim

decision_output.invalid_handling: Explicit invalid/abstain on lost tracking, saturation, stale calibration or missed deadline. Host-approved policy for such objects remains to be agreed; no silent guaranteed safe route.
decision_output.heartbeat: Agreed heartbeat, acknowledgement, stale-data handling, fault semantics and outcome logging required.
decision_output.physical_scope: Output is decision support. Recovery/capture requires separately tested host actuation and outcome measurement.

electrical.status: All remain selection/verification holds; modeled enclosures and connectors are envelopes.
electrical.internal_winding_harness: Unresolved: six independent winding terminal pairs are modeled, but terminal-to-acquisition cable routing, pinout, paired/shielded lead construction and circuit connections are not designed. Shell endpoint contact is not electrical completion.

calibration.accessory: Removable nonmetallic carrier and unselected reference coupon envelope
requires: empty-belt/background scans with host equipment operating
reference objects at representative lateral positions/heights/poses

claim_boundary: CAD establishes geometry only. Existing CV annotation scores are separate evidence and do not validate induction, physical recovery, purity or monetary savings.
